title: Sage Cover
contextTitle: SAGE: Your Student Advising Guidance Engine
context: SAGE is an AI-powered advising platform designed to help students navigate course registration and degree planning at UT Dallas. By combining transcript analysis, degree requirements, and real-time university data, SAGE delivers personalized academic guidance tailored to each student’s goals. Its intelligent chatbot and planning tools streamline the advising process, reducing confusion and improving decision-making.
techStack: SAGE is built as a serverless application using AWS services such as Lambda, DynamoDB, S3, and API Gateway. It leverages Pinecone for vector storage, Gemini models for response generation, and LangChain for retrieval pipelines. The frontend is developed with React.js, Tailwind CSS, and Vite, and deployed via Vercel, with Firebase handling authentication.
solutionOverview: SAGE integrates multiple systems into a unified advising platform, including a transcript parser, degree evaluator, intelligent chatbot, and schedule generator. It uses retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to provide accurate, context-aware responses while also helping students plan optimal course schedules based on degree requirements and professor data.
solutionImpact: Since its launch, SAGE has supported over 2,000 UT Dallas students by simplifying course selection and improving access to academic advising resources. It reduces reliance on manual advising and empowers students to make informed academic decisions efficiently.
designOutcome: The platform emphasizes clarity, usability, and efficiency through a clean, modern interface. A calming green-based color palette fosters focus, while intuitive navigation and structured layouts allow users to seamlessly interact with complex features such as degree planning and chatbot guidance.
